appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads: 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.
Y-axis has major tick marks at intervals of 500, from 0 to 3,500.
X-axis has labeled ticks for years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
A single blue line traces production values across the years.
The data point for 2018 is at approximately 3,500 on the y-axis.
The data point for 2019 is at approximately 2,300 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: Review the Factory F production dashboard for the 2018-2023 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the production trend.
Use the Factory F production dashboard as the evidence source for the production trend routing decision.
The primary field label is 'Production trend route'.
The option labels are: 'Route to production decline response', 'Route to production growth response', 'Route to maintenance scheduling'.
